map.一般不建议。XXTEA 虽修正了原始 TEA 的等价密钥问题，但仍有已知攻击（在: Generally not recommended. Although XXTEA fixed the equivalent-key issue of original TEA, it still has known attacks (breakable under chosen-plaintext) and a block size of only 64 bits, causing birthday-bound problems with large data. New projects should prefer AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 — AEAD algorithms widely analyzed and with integrity checks.
